8	
9	- `GET /healthz` returns HTTP 200 with body `{"status": "ok"}`.
10	- `GET /greet/ada` returns HTTP 200 with body `{"message": "Hello, ada!"}`.
11	- `GET /greet/{name}` greets any valid provided name correctly (e.g. `/greet/Bob` → `{"message": "Hello, Bob!"}`).

13	- Access control is explicitly out of scope: all endpoints are public and read-only, hold no secrets, and perform no writes — documented in the code.
14	- The app object is importable as `hello_python.web:app` and starts under uvicorn on port 8080.
15	- A `Dockerfile` exists that builds the service and runs it on port 8080.

Now I have a clear picture. This is a fresh project that needs a FastAPI application built from scratch. For subtask C1, I need to:
